[EN] Greetings, .
I'm Gislan, the new commander. I gave my pledge to the goddess to keep Velika safe at any cost.
[ES] Saludos, .
Soy Gislan, el nuevo comandante. Le juré a la diosa mantener a Velika a salvo a toda costa.

[EN] Troius! Why have you interrupted our meeting?
[ES] ¡Troius! ¿Por qué interrumpes nuestra reunión?

[EN] The Argons fell back? What could they be up to?
[ES] ¿Los Argons retrocedieron? ¿Qué estarán tramando?

[EN] I'll scramble some reinforcements to Northern Shara. It won't be easy, but it's the right thing to do.
[ES] Reclutaré algunos refuerzos para el norte de Shara. No será fácil, pero es lo correcto.
